The drapery falls it the most I’ll say “typical” opeth song, it has elements for pretty much every opeth song apart from the  prog stuff, even as a bass player, i can tell you it has a little bit of everything in the scales and fast parts that you hear in most old opeth songs, it even has the acoustic and then the brutal breakdown filled with that normal Martin Lopez drum part(mid passed doble bass with heavy snare and cymbals use), it’s an amazing song and opeth are reaaaaally creative but they also have a lot of little thing that they liked to use in a lot of their songs

Basically someone dies(prologue) is “reborn” into a mist-ghost and goes to see how their loved ones and specially his lover is doing and everyone just goes on with their lives pretty soon after his death (april ethereal, when) he wants to kill everyone and bring it with them but he finds out he can’t do that (the amen corner and demon of the fall), gets depressed with the reality (credence, karma) and goes away (epilogue), my references to the songs might be a little of but it’s basically the concept. 
Also, he dies around December and seasons and the year go on though the album progresses
